Issue: Category project grid is not filtered
Evidence (verified live 4 Nov 2026): /dubai/palm-jebel-ali/buy/villas and /dubai/dubai-islands/buy/apartments/2-bed show the same 6 cards (ELA, Azura, Rixos, Ava, Royal Bay, Haven Living). "Load More" pages through all projects of all 3 islands.
Fix required: Filter the grid from the URL: location + listing type (buy/off-plan) + property type + bedrooms (+ frond / villa type / feature / handover / payment plan). Show an empty state with related links when 0 projects match.
How to verify (acceptance): Open 5 category URLs of different islands/types: cards differ and every card matches the page island + type.

Issue: Project filter fields are not saved
Evidence (verified live 4 Nov 2026): Admin Update Property sends listing_type, handover, payment_plan, frond, villa_type, property_feature; response and reload return none of them (tested on 14 projects).
Fix required: Add DB columns + $fillable + API resource; expose the fields on the public property API used by the frontend. Then load the values in tab "Filter Data Plan".
How to verify (acceptance): Set Listing Type on one project, save, reopen: value is still selected and present in the API response.

Issue: Saving a property wipes its brochure PDF
Evidence (verified live 4 Nov 2026): When no new PDF is uploaded, broucher_file is set to null (happened on 23 projects; restored manually). Edit form fills Developer/Type selects 3–5 s after opening.
Fix required: Keep existing file paths when a file input is empty (broucher_file, floor_plan_catalogue, images, all file fields). Disable "Update Property" until the form has fully loaded.
How to verify (acceptance): Open a project with a brochure, change only the price, save: brochure link still on the live page.

Issue: Remaining 404 category routes + 301s for changed URLs
Evidence (verified live 4 Nov 2026): Route validates URL segments against a fixed list. We moved 114 pages to accepted slugs (dubai-island→dubai-islands, manshions→mansions, 6+-bed→6-bed, palm-island→/dubai/buy/<type>); 24 are still 404 because their segments are not allowed.
Fix required: (a) Allow hand-over-2026/2027/2028 and payment-plan-80-20/70-30/60-40 after /off-plan/. (b) Allow PJA design names after /beach-villas/ and /coral-villas/. (c) Add all 301s in tab "301 Redirects".
How to verify (acceptance): Every URL in tab "Routes to Add" returns 200; every old URL in "301 Redirects" returns one 301 to the new URL.

Issue: Hub canonical and footer links point to 404s
Evidence (verified live 4 Nov 2026): /dubai/palm-jumeirah canonical = /palm-jumeirah/ (404) – admin canonical (already set correctly) is ignored. Footer links /palm-jumeirah, /palm-jebel-ali, /dubai-island are 404 on every page.
Fix required: Use admin canonical_url for hub pages. Footer links → /dubai/palm-jumeirah, /dubai/palm-jebel-ali, /dubai/dubai-islands.
How to verify (acceptance): Hub canonical = its own URL; all footer links 200.
